name: ONEG: A Shabbat Experience at 92NY
description: A Friday night program featuring Kabbalat Shabbat blessings, live music, community dialogue, and a kosher-style meal.

name: Midtown Art Deco Tour: The Golden Age of the Skyscraper
description: Discover the golden age of skyscrapers by visiting stunning Art Deco landmarks and lobbies in Midtown. Learn how the architecture of the 20th century evolved and defined the iconic skyline.
short_name: The Golden Age of the Skyscraper

name: "Great British Bake Off" Cake Week
description: Bake and enjoy tea while mastering the cake techniques featured in the Great British Bake Off.

name: How to Cook Pasta Like a Chef
description: A social cooking experience designed to help you meet others while learning the art of pasta making.
short_name: How to Cook Pasta Like a Chef

name: Natalie Tenenbaum: Artist in Residence
description: Composer and pianist Natalie Tenenbaum begins a five-week residency traveling fluidly between classical, jazz, pop, and experimental soundscapes. Her boundary-crossing approach reimagines familiar music in a wholly new way.

name: Ej the DJ
description: Forest Döwn Under presents a dynamic Friday night featuring EJ The DJ and Little Fax The Machine. Expect a night of cutting-edge electronic sounds and club hits.

name: HOLDING LIAT Q&A with Filmmaker Brandon Kramer and Producer Lance Kramer
description: Filmmakers Brandon and Lance Kramer join a post-screening discussion about their documentary focused on reconciliation and peace. The film explores narratives of shared humanity.

name: OBEX
description: Screening followed by a Q&A with director Albert Birney. This lo-fi fantasy nightmare revisits the dawn of personal computing through a mysterious game.

name: Asian Climbing Tribe
description: A safe space for the Asian community to connect, network, and address community issues through climbing.

name: Wine & Cheese Crash Course
description: Join a Murray’s expert for an interactive crash course on wine and cheese pairings. You will taste your way through delicious cheeses and perfect beverage pairings.

name: bLUr
description: Choreographer Kimberly Bartosik explores physical and emotional crisis through dancers navigating urgent interventions and time warps.

name: Gallery Talk | Curator Tour: Renoir Drawings
description: Co-curator Sarah Lees leads a guided tour of the Renoir Drawings exhibition, exploring how the artist used paper to test compositions.

name: MAD for a Cause: Project Street Beat
description: A community-focused event at the museum supporting the Project Street Beat initiative.
short_name: MAD for a Cause: Project Street Beat

name: Lúcio Flávio: The Passenger of Agony
description: Héctor Babenco's thriller follows a notorious bank robber whose fame clashes with the violence of Brazil's police death squad during the military dictatorship. This is a New York premiere of a 4K restoration.
short_name: Lúcio Flávio: The Passenger of Agony

name: Improv Level One Intensive Class Show
description: Graduates of the beginner improv intensive showcase the foundational skills they have learned.
short_name: Improv Level One Intensive Class Show

name: Pink Pier at Watermark
description: Visit this fully immersive pink-themed waterfront destination featuring festive cocktails and photo-ready decor.

name: Jamie xx: In Waves
description: Forward-thinking beatmaker Jamie xx returns to the Armory to kick off his North American tour supporting his release, In Waves. The performance replicates the emotional crescendos and volatility of an almost mystical night out.

name: Washington Heights - Sugar Hill North Harlem Walking Tour
description: A Friday morning exploration of northern Harlem, focusing on the cultural and historical landscape of Washington Heights and North Sugar Hill.
short_name: Washington Heights - Sugar Hill North Harlem Walking Tour

name: Special Waste Drop-Off
description: Safely dispose of harmful household products like motor oil, batteries, and fluorescent bulbs that are illegal to throw in trash or recycling. This service is free for all NYC residents at various sites in all five boroughs.

name: Forest Fridays @ Van Cortlandt Park
description: Join volunteers to save the forest floor by removing invasive species like Bush Honeysuckle and Multiflora Rose. This winter initiative is critical for protecting native plants while they are dormant.

name: Volunteering at Conference House Park - The Blue Wave
description: Participate in a self-directed beach and park clean-up initiative. Volunteers help remove debris and maintain the beauty of the Staten Island waterfront.

name: Ceramics Studio Time - 4-session access block
description: Flexible open studio access block for ceramic artists to work on independent projects with access to pottery wheels and hand-building tables. Clay must be purchased through the makerspace and glaze firing fees apply based on size.

name: Shelter from the Storm: An Artist’s Eye with Stan Allen and Polly Apfelbaum
description: Shelter from the Storm features a collaborative effort between Stan Allen and Polly Apfelbaum, blending architecture and contemporary art. The show examines thematic links between environment, protection, and spatial aesthetics.

name: Revisiting the World of Tomorrow: The 1964-65 World's Fair
location: NYC Department of Records and Information Services (DORIS)
description: An onsite exhibit exploring the 1964-1965 World’s Fair through images, brochures, and ephemera from the Municipal Archives. The display focuses on key areas of the fair including transportation, religion, and commerce.

name: Windows on the Archives
location: NYC Department of Records and Information Services (DORIS)
description: A permanent onsite exhibit displaying the breadth of the City's documentary treasures from the Municipal Archives. The exhibit features records spanning over 300 years of governing and protecting the people of New York City.

name: WSCAH’s 86th Street Market
location: St. Paul & St. Andrew United Methodist Church
description: Each month, customers can receive a regular distribution of USDA MyPlate Balanced groceries. These packages contain a variety of healthy items, including grains, proteins, dairy products, and fresh fruits and vegetables.

name: Primeval Ground [deep, unfathomable]
description: A group exhibition featuring ten artists exploring monochrome and low-chrome artworks across media like photography, weaving, and sculpture. The exhibit includes a panel discussion on Jan 15 and a movement drawing workshop on Jan 24.

name: Video of “Stories Around the Table”
description: A filmed performance featuring current and past members of a writing group that has met for 40 years to discuss aging and creativity. The collective share personal stories sitting around the table, reflecting a rich history of theatrical and literary collaboration.

name: Calling Choreographers: WestFest Dance 2026 Open Call
description: An invitation for choreographers to submit applications for the WestFest Dance 2026 festival. This online application period is open to performing artists seeking to showcase their work in the upcoming season.

name: Somewhere Funny, Nowhere Serious!
description: Somewhere Nowhere NYC transforms into an intimate speakeasy-style comedy club featuring a live stand-up showcase with big-name comedians as seen on Netflix and HBO.

name: Winter Realm Cinema
description: Winter Realm Cinema is a seasonal rooftop film experience in Midtown featuring a fully enclosed and heated terrace with stunning Manhattan views. The program offers a curated selection of cult films, classics, and new releases enjoyed via state-of-the-art wireless headphones. Guests can also enjoy a full bar and classic cinema concessions like fresh popcorn and hot dogs through March 1st.

name: Eternal Nature: Immersive Digital Art Exhibition
description: Experience 'Eternal Nature,' a multisensory digital art exhibition featuring immersive landscapes like crashing waterfalls and blooming forests. The gallery also showcases a landmark collaboration with the Musée d'Orsay, reimagining masterpieces by Monet and Van Gogh through light, sound, and scent.

name: Penguin Feeding
description: Join zoo staff to learn about the diet and habits of the zoo's resident penguins during their scheduled afternoon meal.

name: Junior Tennis Development Program
description: A comprehensive after-school tennis program for students aged 7 to 17, focusing on technical drills, strategic points, and match play. Participants are placed based on age and ability to ensure individual attention and development of sportsmanship.

name: Wunderkammer III
description: Wunderkammer III is an ongoing exhibition located in the Lobby Gallery of Klapper Hall. This exhibition presents a 'cabinet of curiosities' featuring various items from the museum's permanent collection. It is currently open to visitors while the main museum undergoes installation.

name: Karaoke Friday
description: Join the Gottscheer Hall community for their signature Friday night karaoke. Experience a wide selection of German beers and pub eats while enjoying or participating in an evening of singing and entertainment.

name: Live Music
description: Grand Vin hosts live music performances Wednesday through Saturday nights, creating a sophisticated ambiance for dining and drinks. Guests can enjoy a rotating selection of musicians while exploring the venue's curated wine list and Italian-inspired menu.

name: New York Latin American Art Triennial
description: This exhibition showcases contemporary works from Latin American artists as part of the city-wide Triennial event. The gallery presents a diverse range of artistic practices and cultural perspectives through mixed media installations.
short_name: New York Latin American Art Triennial

name: Nutcracker Rouge
description: A perennial smash hit burlesque reimagining of the classic holiday tale featuring a hedonistic mix of circus, opera, and cabaret. This Drama Desk-nominated production is a sensual blend of music hall and theater in an opulent Brooklyn palace.

name: Cocktail Magique
description: A spectacular farewell run of this playful burlesque revue that blends world-class magic with tantalizing variety acts and bespoke cocktails. After over 575 performances, this immersive production takes its final bow on February 8.

name: Inuuteq Storch: Soon Will Summer Be Over
description: This exhibition features the photography of Inuuteq Storch, documenting the sublime landscapes and intimate daily life of Greenland. Through a personal lens, the artist explores themes of identity, environment, and cultural heritage.
short_name: Inuuteq Storch: Soon Will Summer Be Over

name: Vaginal Davis: Magnificent Product
description: A major exhibition spanning five decades of Vaginal Davis’s practice as a performer, visual artist, author, and countercultural icon. The presentation highlights her role as an underground trailblazer in queer politics and her uncompromising glamour.

name: Four Dilations
description: Four Dilations presents artistic positions that challenge dominant contemporary methods of timekeeping. The title references the physical phenomenon of temporal dilation, where time passes at different rates for observers in different frames of reference.

name: Gabrielle Goliath: Personal Accounts
description: This video series responds to the impacts of patriarchal violence across global contexts from Johannesburg to Kyiv. The installation intimately documents survivor testimonials by focusing on the sighs, breaths, and moments between spoken words.

name: Homeroom: LA ESCUELA___ Education as Resistance
description: Artist-run platform LA ESCUELA___ initiates a collective learning project charting radical pedagogies from across Latin America. This program explores how education can serve as a form of resistance within contemporary art spaces.

name: Ayoung Kim: Delivery Dancer Codex
description: Artist Ayoung Kim presents the US debut of her Delivery Dancer trilogy, utilizing generative AI and videogame engines to create narratives. Her work explores the collision of geopolitics, digital technologies, and synthesized mythologies.

name: The Housemaid
description: Millie accepts a live-in housemaid job for a wealthy couple, but the dream job unravels into a dangerous game of secrets.

name: Rewind by Whisbe
description: A contemporary art installation by artist WhIsBe featuring oversized childhood toy sculptures ranging from 6 to 16 feet tall. The display includes pieces like a 10-foot rocket ship and a 15-foot dinosaur, reflecting on innocence and resilience.

name: Friday Feel-Good Improv Jam
description: Kick off the weekend with a high-energy, supportive improv jam open to all. Whether you're a seasoned pro or a first-timer, this jam is all about having fun and making good choices on stage.

name: Character Counts Open Mic
description: Hosted by Liz Coin, this open mic is dedicated specifically to developing characters. Performers get five-minute slots to workshop existing characters or debut brand new ones.

name: UNIQLO Friday Nights
description: The museum stays open late every Friday night with free admission for New York State residents. Guests can enjoy exhibitions, drop-in drawing, film screenings, and unique shopping at the Design Store.

name: Smalls Afternoon Jam Session Hosted by Andrew Kushnir
description: An open jazz jam session featuring a professional house trio and hosted by drummer Andrew Kushnir. Musicians are invited to join the stage for an afternoon of communal music-making.
short_name: Smalls Afternoon Jam Session Hosted by Andrew Kushnir

name: Against Time: The Noguchi Museum 40th Anniversary Reinstallation
description: This special reinstallation celebrates the 40th anniversary of The Noguchi Museum by showcasing the enduring vision of Isamu Noguchi. The exhibition highlights the history of the museum and its unique integration of building and garden.

name: Art + You: Gallery Conversations
description: A monthly session for visitors aged 18-30 to reflect and exchange perspectives on select artworks through guided dialogue. Each session is led by a Whitney Educator and focuses on intimate, thoughtful reflections of pieces currently on view.

name: Free Friday Night Hip Hop Dance Class & Party
description: Join Ailey Extension instructor TweetBoogie for a free hip hop dance class followed by a high-energy dance party featuring sets by DJ Bizzy. All ages and skill levels are welcome to participate in this vibrant Friday evening event.
short_name: Free Friday Night Hip Hop Dance Class & Party

name: Adult Cooking Class — Tasty Thai
description: Master the flavors of Thailand by preparing Pad Thai, Pineapple Chicken Satay with nut-free Thai sauce, and fresh veggie summer rolls. This BYOB workshop is entirely hands-on and designed for all skill levels.

name: Alpine Luxe: The Ski Chalet Experience at Industry Kitchen
description: Experience an upscale ski chalet vibe at Industry Kitchen, featuring seasonal alpine-inspired decor and a specialized winter menu. This immersive dining installation brings mountain luxury to the NYC waterfront.

name: Athi-Patra Ruga: Lord, I gotta keep on (movin’)
description: This multidisciplinary exhibition centers on myths, their creation, and their relationship to power and liberation through performance, film, painting, and textile. Ruga creates allegorical figures that draw from Xhosa history and post-apartheid South Africa to explore race and sexuality.

name: David Wojnarowicz: Arthur Rimbaud in New York
description: A series of photo-performances documenting New York City's decay in the late 1970s through the persona of poet Arthur Rimbaud. The exhibition features gelatin silver prints that intuitively connect the state of anarchy in post-Commune Paris with the artist's own predicament as a street survivor.

name: Soft Spaces
description: An on-view exhibition that explores contemporary queer identity and space through diverse artistic perspectives. The show engages with themes of the body and domesticity within the context of the museum's collection.

name: Artist Studios: Eva Tellier
description: Visit artist Eva Tellier in her studio to explore her latest works and creative process. This recurring studio residency allows visitors to engage directly with contemporary makers.

name: SUE: The T. rex Experience
description: Step into the world of SUE, the most complete and best-preserved Tyrannosaurus rex ever discovered, featuring a 40-foot-long skeleton replica. This interactive exhibition uses high-tech simulations and sensory effects to depict the prehistoric Cretaceous forest.

name: Fulton Fish Market Public Hours
description: Visit the historic Fulton Fish Market, one of the world's largest seafood wholesalers, during its early morning public hours. Explore a massive selection of fresh seafood and connect with specialized vendors in a unique wholesale environment. Visitors are encouraged to arrive before 5:00 AM for the best variety and supply availability.

name: Friday Night at MFAW
location: Music for a While Listening Bar & Lounge
description: Experience an immersive late-night music escape featuring stories and global sounds in an intimate underground setting. This Friday night session offers a unique listening bar atmosphere beneath the cosmopolitan heart of the city.

name: Joan Jonas: Moving off the Land II (Excerpts)
location: Columbia University Lenfest Center for the Arts
description: This multimedia exhibition features drawings of red fish by alumna Joan Jonas, scaled up into stunning banners. The installation explores the science and storytelling of the world's oceans as part of a yearlong 60th anniversary celebration.

name: Heidi Latsky Dance: Who Am I Now?
description: A special presentation blending film, performance, and conversation to explore resilience, identity, and the artist's recovery journey.
short_name: Heidi Latsky Dance: Who Am I Now?

name: Member Morning Hours
description: Museum members and their guests are invited to explore the exhibitions before the building opens to the general public.

name: Member Storytime
description: Led by expert educators, this monthly program brings the Museum’s collections to life for young learners through the joy of storytelling.

name: A Night at the Museum: The Overnight Experience
description: Guests explore their favorite halls and fall asleep under the iconic Blue Whale or surrounded by other beloved Museum exhibits.

name: Seneca Village Educators' Tour
description: Join Central Park Conservancy guides for a tour exploring the history of the Seneca Village community, designed specifically for NYC educators. Participants will learn about the displacement of residents for the construction of the park.

name: Intro to MIG Welding: Half-Day Intensive - Brooklyn
description: Learn the fundamentals of Metal Inert Gas welding, the simplest form of joining steel. This hands-on workshop covers equipment setup, safety, and basic welding beads.

name: Joey Diaz: 62 & Still Slinging
description: Joey "Coco" Diaz brings his powerhouse stand-up comedy and legendary storytelling to the stage. Known for his wild and unpredictable performances, Diaz is a veteran of film, television, and hit podcasts.

name: Lost Highway
description: David Lynch's dreamlike journey through a murder mystery screening in 35mm.

name: Bookstore
description: A play exploring human connections and stories set within the quiet sanctuary of a bookstore environment.

name: goat season official capricorn takeover
description: The official Capricorn takeover continues with a "GOAT" themed celebration. Experience a high-energy night with the best tracks and a vibrant crowd.

name: Between Two Drummers I
description: This rhythm-focused showcase features dynamic percussion performances and intricate collaborative improvisation.

name: Mulchfest
description: Participate in the annual NYC tradition of recycling your Christmas tree into mulch. Trees will be chipped on-site, and mulch will be available for participants to take home.

name: Overnights January 10
description: Sleep over on the legendary Intrepid and get exclusive night-time access to the ship and Space Shuttle Pavilion. Sleep among the aircraft just like enlisted sailors once did.

name: Meet Daniel Tiger
description: Meet Daniel Tiger for a special greeting and explore his neighborhood in this interactive exhibit for young learners.

name: Public Tour of "With a Single Step"
description: A guided gallery tour of MOCA’s core exhibition providing an overview of Chinese history in America from the 19th century to the present.
short_name: Public Tour of "With a Single Step"

name: Collage Revisited (1988, 2025) / Story/ (2013)
description: The Company revisits the final collaboration of Bill T. Jones and Arnie Zane alongside a work using John Cage’s indeterminacy.

name: Winter Knitting with Hilary Snell
description: Build on your knitting foundation this winter in biweekly classes designed to improve your technique and craft.

name: La Casa De Bernarda Alba
description: Federico García Lorca’s classic drama about a widow who imposes an eight-year mourning period on her five daughters.

name: Studio Signs: From Now: A Collection in Context
description: A discussion related to the exhibition "Studio Signs: From Now: A Collection in Context."
short_name: From Now: A Collection in Context

name: Robinson's Readers: Story Time and Craft
description: Little kids (and their grown-ups), join us for a monthly educator-facilitated picture book story time and hands-on craft inspired by the life and legacy of Jackie Robinson.
short_name: Robinson's Readers: Story Time and Craft

name: Adam Pascal & Anthony Rapp: Celebrating Friendship & History
description: Original stars of RENT return to share an unforgettable night of music and stories from their long friendship and legendary careers.

name: La vérité sur Bébé Donge (1952)
description: This French film noir deftly mixes wit and cruelty as it captures the thoughts of a murderer and her victim. It stars Danielle Darrieux and Jean Gabin in a dark tale of betrayal.

name: L'Horloger de Saint-Paul (1974)
description: Bertrand Tavernier's breakthrough success brings compassion and depth to an adaptation of a novel by Georges Simenon. The film features a melancholic beauty and poetic cinematography.

name: Winter Birding Tour
description: Join expert birder Alexandra Wang for a guided tour to spot resident birds and seasonal winter visitors.

name: MLK Weekend Service Project
description: Join the Alliance for a special weekend of community service and park stewardship.

name: The Revisionist: Staged Reading & Discussion
location: New York Society for Ethical Culture
description: A staged reading of Jesse Eisenberg's play about a young American writer visiting his cousin in Poland.

name: Knitting Foundation Class
description: Build on your knitting foundation this winter in classes led by Hilary Snell, held biweekly at Scandinavia House.

name: Lil' Studio
description: An early childhood program for kids under five featuring reading, singing, movement, and art making to build developmental skills.

name: USPML Learn-and-Play Meetup
description: The United States Professional Mahjong League hosts an inclusive session for players to learn and practice mahjong techniques.

name: Movement Speaks Teacher Training: 3-Day Intensive
description: A hands-on professional training intensive focused on creative aging and inclusive dance methods for older adults. Participants learn to lead accessible programs that support wellness and community connection through movement.

name: Certain Restrictions Do Apply: New Textile Works
description: A landmark textile exhibition featuring new works by Carolyn Mazloomi and Sharon Kerry-Harlan. The exhibition mines the history of Black American pioneers and expands the narrative of quiltmaking and textile art.

name: Central Harlem Walking Tour
description: The definitive tour of the heart of Harlem, exploring landmarks and the vibrant cultural legacy of Central Harlem.

name: Guided Tour of The Jim Henson Exhibition
description: A special guided tour exploring the creative legacy of Jim Henson and his iconic work with the Muppets.
short_name: Guided Tour of The Jim Henson Exhibition

name: Gallery Hours
description: BioBAT Art Space is open to the public every Saturday, offering visitors a chance to explore exhibitions at the intersection of biology, technology, ecology, and design. The gallery is located within the historic Brooklyn Army Terminal and features works from artists and design innovators.

name: Penn Station & Moynihan Train Hall Tour
description: Discover the architectural history of the original Penn Station and its modern counterpart, the Moynihan Train Hall. This tour traces remnants of the 1910 masterpiece and explores the rise of the landmarks preservation movement.
short_name: Penn Station & Moynihan Train Hall Tour

name: Willy Wonka & the Chocolate Factory
description: Enter a world of pure imagination in this classic 1971 musical fantasy starring Gene Wilder as the enigmatic candy maker.

name: The Saturday Jam
description: The PIT's signature Saturday evening improv jam. It's an open-to-all session where improvisers can work on their skills and play in front of a live audience in a welcoming environment.

name: Ladies Stand-Up! (Men Sit Down) Open Mic
description: A weekly stand-up open mic dedicated specifically to female and non-binary comedians to hone their craft in a supportive, focused space.

name: Staged Reading: Jesse Eisenberg's The Revisionist
location: New York Society for Ethical Culture
description: A staged reading and discussion of Jesse Eisenberg's play about a young American writer who visits his elderly cousin in Poland. The performance explores themes of family legacy, personal truth, and the stories we tell ourselves.

name: Adult Cooking Class — Fresh Handmade Pasta
description: Learn the art of making fresh pasta from scratch, including fettuccine and spinach ricotta ravioli paired with a classic tomato sauce. Enjoy this social, vegetarian-friendly cooking experience with your favorite wine or beer.
short_name: Adult Cooking Class — Fresh Handmade Pasta

name: Coffee Bark
description: Coffee Bark is an opportunity for Brooklyn dog owners to gather in the park for treats and coffee. It provides a community space for networking and socializing among local pet owners.

name: Audubon Nature Exploration
description: Join the Alliance for nature education programs held on weekends for all ages. These discovery sessions help visitors learn about local wildlife and the park's ecosystem.

name: Artist Studios: Jayoung Yoon
description: Artist Jayoung Yoon opens her studio doors to the public every Saturday. Experience her unique approach to contemporary art and see her works in progress.

name: Lil' Studio
description: Parents and caregivers of children under five are invited to the Harlem Library for art-making and bonding activities. This program aims to bring museum-quality creative experiences directly into the local community.

name: Saturday Night at MFAW
location: Music for a While Listening Bar & Lounge
description: Join us for a curated evening of music and connection at this underground sanctuary. Saturday nights at MFAW transform the lounge into a vibrant tapestry of sounds, culture, and memories.

name: Rashid Johnson’s Rotunda Stage Performance Series
description: Poets, spoken word performers, and vocalists activate Rashid Johnson’s Rotunda Stage in a series of weekly performances. This series brings dynamic literary and vocal art to the heart of the museum.
short_name: Rashid Johnson’s Rotunda Stage Performance Series

name: Maybe Happy Ending Tickets
description: Winner of 6 Tony Awards, including Best Musical, _Maybe Happy Ending_ is the story of a chance encounter that sparks connection, adventure, and maybe even love.

name: PBR: Unleas h th e Beast
description: The PBR Monster Energy Buck Off features the top cowboys in the world taking on the rankest and biggest bulls in professional bull riding. This three-day event is a premier showcase of grit and athleticism in the heart of the city.
short_name: PBR: Unleas h th e Beast

name: Astoria Philosophy Book Club
description: A community-driven discussion group exploring philosophical texts and big ideas in a casual, approachable setting.

name: Open Mic (Free w/ $5 Bar Purchase!)
description: A low-stakes environment for comedians of all levels to practice new material. Free entry with a modest bar purchase.

name: Chelsea Market, High Line & Hudson Yards Food & History Tour
description: A guided walking tour that blends local food tastings with the rich architectural and social history of West Manhattan.
short_name: Chelsea Market, High Line & Hudson Yards Food & History Tour

name: NYRR Open Run: Canarsie Park
description: NYRR Open Run brings free, weekly community-led 5K runs to neighborhood parks.

name: Chiharu Shiota: Two Home Countries
description: This solo exhibition by artist Chiharu Shiota features large-scale thread installations that explore themes of memory and the concept of home.

name: Zumba
description: Zumba is a fusion of Latin, International and popular music dance themes creating a dynamic fitness system.

name: Saul Rubin Zebtet
description: Guitarist Saul Rubin leads his Zebtet for a gritty, late-night session at Smalls, blending intricate arrangements with open improvisation.

name: Round Midnight Solo Piano With William Hill III
description: An intimate late-night solo piano set at Mezzrow, featuring William Hill III exploring timeless jazz standards.

name: BLKNWS: Terms & Conditions
description: A cinematic adaptation of Kahlil Joseph's video art installation weaving fiction and history into an immersive journey through Black consciousness.

name: Cronos
description: Guillermo del Toro’s feature debut tells the story of an antiques dealer who discovers an ancient golden device with sinister and addictive powers.

name: Frankenstein
description: Oscar-winning director Guillermo del Toro adapts Mary Shelley’s classic tale of a scientist whose experiment brings a tragic creature to life.

name: Jay Kelly
description: Academy Award nominee Noah Baumbach follows a movie actor and his manager on an unexpectedly profound journey through Europe.

name: Best of Brooklyn Stand-Up Comedy
description: Catch top-tier stand-up featuring pro and rising stars from HBO, Comedy Central, and Netflix in an intimate setting. Guests can enjoy social board games and a variety of drinks with no two-item minimum requirement.

name: New Talent/Weekly Stand Up Auditions
description: Support the future of comedy by attending a showcase featuring promising new talent and club auditions. This show features comedians newer to the club scene in front of a real audience with no bringer fee or extra strings attached.

name: Live Jazz at Nook
description: Relax and enjoy an evening of live jazz music performed by rotating artists. This weekly series offers a smooth and sophisticated atmosphere for music lovers.

name: Henry Mena & Friends
description: Late night musical performances featuring Henry Mena alongside various guest collaborators.

name: Screenings from The Paley Archive
description: Experience curated daily screenings of iconic media from the Paley Center's extensive archive, showcasing television history and culture. These public presentations highlight rare broadcast treasures and influential programming from decades past.

name: PJ Library & 92NY Jewish Children’s Book Festival
description: A family-friendly festival featuring author meet-and-greets, creative workshops, crafts, live music, and free book giveaways.
short_name: PJ Library & 92NY Jewish Children’s Book Festival

name: Poetry Workshops: Monet and Venice
description: A generative writing workshop inspired by the Monet and Venice exhibition, drawing parallels between the Gowanus Canal and Venice’s waterways. Open to all experience levels.

name: The Royal Gala Concert
description: This gala features winners of the Royal Music Competition 2025 performing with artists from Juilliard and the New York Philharmonic.

name: NieR:Orchestra Concert re:12024 [ the end of data ]
description: A multimedia production featuring a full orchestra and choir performing music from the NieR game series with high-definition projections.
short_name: Orchestra Concert re:12024 [ the end of data ]

name: Somi: A Well-Being Concert
description: Grammy-nominated vocalist Somi leads an uplifting concert that combines live jazz and soul music with explorations of mindfulness.

name: Michel Pascal: Hip Hope Youth for Peace
description: Opening NYC’s Peace Week 2026, this concert unites youth and artists through music, beatboxing, and messages of social restoration.
short_name: Michel Pascal: Hip Hope Youth for Peace

name: How to Cook Shellfish
description: Overcome your fear of cooking seafood by learning to prep clams, mussels, shrimp, and squid.

name: Classic French Pastries
description: Become comfortable with advanced baking techniques while creating elegant and classic French desserts.

name: Culinary Boot Camp: Vegetarian Techniques
description: A five-week intensive series focusing on fundamental cooking skills through a vegetarian lens.

name: Vong Pak's Binari
description: A powerful contemporary reimagining of the Korean shamanic blessing ritual known as Binari. Award-winning performer Vong Pak blends ancestral rhythms with jazz influences and experimental energy.

name: Binghamton Vibes Winter Tour
description: Binghamton Vibes stops in NYC as part of their seasonal winter tour.

name: Jo Harrop
description: Soulful jazz vocalist Jo Harrop performs with Chris Seefried, Jonny Flaugher, and Rich Pagano.

name: Mission: Impossible
description: A special 35mm screening of Brian De Palma’s elegant thriller to mark the final day of the Mission: Impossible exhibition.

name: Experimental Nature Documentary
description: A structurally perfect experimental documentary following a paleobotanist cataloging native plants in Normandy.

name: Personal Thriller: Prison Official
description: A personal thriller following a mechanic who believes he has encountered his former torturer from prison.

name: Warming Winter Yoga
description: Practice yoga in the majestic Armor Hall with panoramic winter views.

name: Second Sunday Castle Tours
description: Take a guided tour of the historic Castle at Fort Totten with the Bayside Historical Society.

name: Hoppy Rabbit Playdate (January)
description: Families can bring children to a cozy indoor playground to socialize and enjoy age-appropriate activities supported by Mandarin-speaking educators.

name: Studio Visit with 2025 National Design Award Winner Melitta Baumeister
description: Visit the Greenpoint studio of fashion designer Melitta Baumeister to learn about sculptural silhouettes and innovative garment techniques.

name: From Bossa to Swing: Jobim and Getz
description: Pianist Caelan Cardello leads a dynamic ensemble in this lively tribute to the iconic collaboration between Antônio Carlos Jobim and Stan Getz.
short_name: From Bossa to Swing: Jobim and Getz

name: New Jazz Underground
description: This electrifying trio pairs lyrical melodies and rich harmonies with bold, adventurous improvisation to preview music from their upcoming debut album.

name: Sean Mason Trio
description: Pianist Sean Mason returns with his trio to unveil brand-new music shaped by vivid storytelling, bold grooves, and fearless exploration.

name: Giant Step 35.5 Years Celebration at Winter Jazzfest
description: Giant Step celebrates 35.5 years as part of Winter Jazzfest with an evening of soul and jazz-infused sounds.

name: Believing and Belonging Membership Class
description: A welcoming class for those considering membership or looking to explore the mission of the church community.

short_name: oskar med k: Make Me Feel Tour 2026

name: Gogol Bordello
description: The legendary gypsy punk band brings their chaotic and infectious energy for a high-octane live show. Expect a riotous blend of Eastern European folk, punk rock, and theatrical performance.

name: Enigma Variations & Bruch’s Violin Concerto
location: David Geffen Hall at Lincoln Center
description: Nikolaj Szeps-Znaider leads Bruch’s Violin Concerto No. 1 and Elgar’s legendary Enigma Variations.

name: Kyle Kinane
description: Kyle Kinane brings his gravelly voice and unique observations to the stage for a night of stand-up.

name: Ernest: Live from the South Tour
description: Country singer-songwriter ERNEST brings his "LIVE FROM THE SOUTH TOUR" to the Big Apple. Known for his storytelling, he delivers an authentic and heartfelt country music experience.
short_name: Ernest: Live from the South Tour

name: Robot Song
description: A dazzling theater work for kids and adults celebrating inclusion and creativity.

name: Boojum & Hot Like Mars
description: Loop Troupe presents "Electric Wonderland on Mars," a cosmic and funky live music experience.

name: Aaron Burnett and the Big Machine: Quantum Breaks II
description: New “Jazztronica” compositions inspired by electronic music techniques, UK drum ‘n’ bass, and hip-hop.

name: Steven Wendt: Plato Caves: Screens vs Shadows
description: Scientist Steven explores how shadows and sounds can match up to make feelings happen, loosely using Plato’s Allegory of the Cave. This performance is open to all ages, specifically designed for children 5 to 12 years old.

name: Bill Frisell: 75th Birthday Celebration
description: "In My Dreams" features Frisell with longtime collaborators Jenny Scheinman, Hank Roberts, and others in a sonic reunion.

name: Freak & Donna & Friends: The Finale!
description: This grand finale show features the premiere of the Freak & Donna series ender along with live talent performances.

name: Bach: St. John Passion
description: A deeply moving musical journey through Christ’s final hours, featuring intimate arias, urgent choruses, and beautiful chorales. This Lent concert offers a profound musical gateway into the heart of Holy Week.

name: Fagtasia Presents: She-Cago
description: A high-energy, campy, and theatrical comedy show brought to life by the Fagtasia performers.

name: Solar Cross, Invunche, Conifere, Iron Firmament, Keys to the Astral Gates, Druhtiz
description: A dark assembly of black metal and atmospheric extreme music featuring diverse international acts.
short_name: Solar Cross, Invunche, Conifere, Iron Firmament, Keys to the Astral Gates, Druhtiz

name: Teacher, Teacher: Kiyoshi Kurosawa’s Serpent’s Path and Chime
description: A double feature highlighting the works of Kiyoshi Kurosawa, including the gangland thriller Serpent’s Path and the psychological featurette Chime.
short_name: Kiyoshi Kurosawa’s Serpent’s Path and Chime

name: Neuroscience WIP series: Emily Schoenblum, Roozie Coenen
description: Research presentations from Emily Schoenblum and Roozie Coenen as part of the neuroscience works in progress series.

name: An Evening With Lynne Koplitz. Special Event.
description: Renowned comedian Lynne Koplitz performs a special headline set at the Broadway Comedy Club.

name: Alpha
description: A troubled 13-year-old and her mother face a collapsing world after she returns from school with a mysterious new tattoo.

name: Prada2000
description: International rising star PRADA2000 performs a high-energy set of trancy melodies and bouncy basslines. His sound is fast, fun, and emotional, designed to keep a high-energy dance floor locked in.

name: Féile na Gaeilge / Irish Language Day 2026
description: A day-long celebration of the Irish language featuring story-focused workshops, conversation circles, and short films.
short_name: Féile na Gaeilge / Irish Language Day 2026

name: Gearrscannáin na Gaeilge / Irish Language Shorts
description: A screening of contemporary Irish language short films across various genres including comedy, drama, and history.
short_name: Gearrscannáin na Gaeilge / Irish Language Shorts

name: Seanchoíche
description: A storytelling night where volunteer speakers share personal narratives and poetry in the Irish language on the theme of "Home."

name: The Music of Taylor Swift: A Symphonic Tribute
description: A full orchestra performs symphonic arrangements of Taylor Swift's greatest hits from throughout her career.

name: Old 97's
description: Alt-country pioneers Old 97's return to the stage with support from artist Lizzie No. The band is celebrated for their energetic blend of power pop and traditional country roots.

name: Cock Sparrer
description: Legendary Oi! and punk rock band Cock Sparrer celebrate decades of anthemic songs for a two-night stand.

name: Mister Cobra
description: Lucy Liyou combines Korean folk opera and drag-inspired techniques in a solo performance confronting the boundaries of transition and personhood.

name: Uncle Vanya, scenes from country life
description: A new production of Chekhov’s classic play depicting the complexities of human longing and regret.
short_name: Uncle Vanya, scenes from country life

name: Kyle Kinane
description: Stand-up comedian Kyle Kinane brings his unique observations and storytelling to the stage for a night of laughs.

name: Hekate Supper: Performative Lecture with Artist Kay Turner
description: Artist and scholar Kay Turner presents a performative lecture on the archetype of the Greek goddess Hekate. The session explores mythology related to crossroads and the moon, including historical ritual suppers.

name: Street Tree Care with plant xchange
description: Partner with plant xchange for a volunteer street tree care session. Help steward the urban canopy through mulching, weeding, and general maintenance of city trees.

name: Philharmonic Families: Winds
description: An interactive concert designed for children that focuses on the wind family of the orchestra. Musicians from the Philharmonic demonstrate the unique sounds of the woodwinds in a fun environment.

name: Wynonna In Concert
description: Country music superstar Wynonna Judd performs a Red Carpet GALA benefit concert. The evening celebrates the best of country music while supporting the mission of the non-profit St. George Theatre.

name: Little Syria & the Lower West Side
description: Remember the vital immigrant community of the Lower West Side and the Arabic-speaking enclave known as Little Syria. This tour uncovers the history of a neighborhood that served as the mother colony for the Arab American diaspora.
short_name: Little Syria & the Lower West Side

name: Lavoe En Sinfónica
location: Lehman Center for the Performing Arts
description: Award-winning actor and vocalist Raúl Carbonell reprises his legendary portrayal of Héctor Lavoe in this special theatrical concert. Lavoe’s timeless anthems are elevated by the Héctor Lavoe Band and a full symphonic ensemble.

name: ripple & rip: marbling & collage
description: A contemporary take on the traditional art of marbling combined with collage techniques. Instructor Nazli Efe leads this two-session exploration of mixed media paper arts.

name: Laveda
description: Ethereal shoegaze and dreampop project Laveda performs live, bringing lush soundscapes to Night Club 101.

name: Tennis Courts, Paper Lady, Range Life
description: A late-night triple bill featuring the guitar-driven indie and dream-pop sounds of Tennis Courts, Paper Lady, and Range Life.
short_name: Tennis Courts, Paper Lady, Range Life

name: Martini Russa
description: Award-winning duo featuring acoustic and electric guitars with female vocals.

name: Improv Night with International Guests
description: An improvising duo from Germany (accordion and electric guitar) perform alongside NYC improvisers.

name: Glicky's Connection
description: A high-energy blend of Roadhouse, Alt Country, Rock'n'Roll, and Rockabilly.

name: Last Heroes: OPIA Tour
description: Electronic duo Last Heroes brings their melodic bass and cinematic soundscapes to NYC for the OPIA Tour.

name: Nidia Góngora: Afro-Colombian Music
description: Experience the soulful currents of the Colombian Pacific coast with Latin Grammy-nominated singer Nidia Góngora.

name: Israeli Chamber Project
description: An ensemble of award-winning Israeli musicians performs a program of classical and contemporary chamber works.

name: Drain
description: California hardcore band Drain brings their high-intensity, surf-influenced thrash to the stage. Be prepared for a high-energy show and significant crowd participation.

name: Open Movement: Subject to Object: Self as Text
description: Jerron Harmon leads a workshop centering disability aesthetics to translate personal memory into shared movement and sound contexts.
short_name: Subject to Object: Self as Text

name: Meshell Ndegeocello
description: As part of NYC Winter Jazzfest, this performance features the restlessly collaborative and multi-disciplinary artistry of Meshell Ndegeocello.

name: Brooklyn Nets vs. Sacramento Kings
description: The Brooklyn Nets take on the Sacramento Kings in a Sunday matchup. Close out the weekend with world-class NBA action in Brooklyn.

name: Milo Rau & Servane Dècle: The Pelicot Trial
description: An urgent North American premiere featuring readings of examinations, pleas, and commentaries from the historic Mazan rape case trial. This production confronts the global system of patriarchy and violence against women.

name: Virtual Stations of the Cross
description: An online time of prayer and reflection exploring 15 stations of the cross through visual art, music, scripture, and prayer.

name: Organ Recital: Ken Cowan
description: Master organist Ken Cowan demonstrates the power and versatility of St. Bart's organ in a program of virtuosic compositions. One of the world's largest pipe organs is showcased in this solo recital.

name: Beethoven’s Fifth Symphony
description: Host Rob Kapilow breaks down the intricacies and genius of Beethoven’s iconic Fifth Symphony in a lecture-performance format.

name: Works & Process: The Metropolitan Opera - Kaija Saariaho’s Innocence
description: A preview of the final opera by Kaija Saariaho with excerpts and a discussion moderated by Peter Gelb.
short_name: The Metropolitan Opera - Kaija Saariaho’s Innocence

name: Drain
description: Hardcore powerhouse Drain brings their aggressive energy and thrash-influenced sound to the stage. Prepare for an intense night of heavy riffs and high-octane performance.

name: African Apocalypse Movie Screening
description: A screening of African Apocalypse followed by a Q&A with filmmaker Rob Lemkin. The film follows the trail of colonial soldier Paul Voulet and explores the legacy of destruction in Nigerian communities.

name: Tana French celebrates THE KEEPER
description: Acclaimed mystery author Tana French celebrates her book The Keeper as part of the Midday Mystery virtual series. This event features a live discussion with the author.

name: Nmixx 1st World Tour [Episode 1: Zero Frontier]
description: K-pop sensation NMIXX brings their "MIXX POP" sound and powerful choreography for their first world tour.

name: Eilen Jewell
description: Singer-songwriter Eilen Jewell performs her signature blend of country, noir-blues, and soulful roots music.

name: Brooklyn Nets vs. Charlotte Hornets
description: The Brooklyn Nets host the Charlotte Hornets in a Tuesday night conference game. Catch all the dunks and three-pointers live in Brooklyn.

name: Screening | Pull My Daisy, Musical Performance, Q&A
description: A special event featuring the screening of the Beat classic 'Pull My Daisy' alongside a live musical performance and discussion.
short_name: Screening | Pull My Daisy, Musical Performance, Q&A

name: Sally Baby's Silver Dollars
description: A musical performance featuring the soulful vocal styling and classic arrangements of Sally Baby's Silver Dollars.

name: Moonchild: Waves Tour
description: The LA-based trio Moonchild brings their smooth blend of alternative R&B and jazz to NYC. Their lush arrangements and soulful harmonies create a beautiful and relaxed live atmosphere.

name: Film Screening: Woman at War
description: The environmental fable "Woman at War" follows an Icelandic activist waging a solo war on the local aluminum industry.

name: Madison Cunningham: The Ace Tour
description: Grammy-winning singer-songwriter and guitarist Madison Cunningham performs music from her acclaimed albums as part of her Ace Tour.

name: Stick Men
description: Progressive rock trio featuring members of King Crimson performing on the Chapman Stick and electronic percussion.

name: Book Launch: Susan Cheever
description: Author Susan Cheever discusses her new book When All the Men Wore Hats with Chair of Fiction Luis Jaramillo. The book explores mid-century culture through reflections on her father's work.

name: Ryan Caraveo: Forever Foggy Tour
description: Ryan Caraveo brings his vulnerable and genre-blending hip-hop to the stage as part of his national tour.

name: rusowsky
description: Spanish artist rusowsky brings his unique blend of bedroom pop and electronic music to Brooklyn. His sound often incorporates jazz and R&B elements into a modern indie framework.

name: Season Finale: Jeffrey Siegel
description: Pianist Jeffrey Siegel closes the Keyboard Conversations season with uplifting music by Bach, Grieg, and Schumann.

name: The Meteors
description: The kings of psychobilly return to deliver their unique brand of high-octane rockabilly-punk.

name: Rachel Sumner & Traveling Light
description: The Boston-based trio performs 'Femericana'—a blend of folk tradition with feminist storytelling and poetic detail. Led by award-winning songwriter Rachel Sumner, the group features spare, intimate arrangements for guitar, bass, and fiddle.

name: David Cross: Shootin’ the Shit, Seein’ What Sticks
description: Legendary comedian David Cross performs his show "Shootin’ the Shit, Seein’ What Sticks" in an intimate setting at Union Hall.
short_name: Shootin’ the Shit, Seein’ What Sticks

name: Shimza
description: South African DJ Shimza brings his powerful Afro-tech and deep house grooves to the main stage.

name: On Cinema – the Certified “Five Bags of Popcorn” Tour
description: Tim Heidecker and Gregg Turkington bring their legendary movie review show to life on the Five Bags of Popcorn Tour. A must-see for fans of the cult-favorite On Cinema universe.
short_name: On Cinema – the Certified “Five Bags of Popcorn” Tour

name: The Brook & The Bluff Werewolf Tour
description: Nashville-based band The Brook & The Bluff brings their Werewolf Tour and signature harmonies to Webster Hall.
short_name: The Brook & The Bluff Werewolf Tour

name: Alash Ensemble
description: Masters of Tuvan throat singing, the Alash trio performs traditional music infused with subtle modern influences. They showcase the remarkable technique of singing multiple pitches simultaneously while incorporating western musical elements.

name: Nothing
description: Shoegaze band Nothing brings their atmospheric and heavy wall-of-sound to Brooklyn. Known for their immersive live shows, the band blends melody with crushing volume.

name: Brooklyn Nets vs. Atlanta Hawks
description: The Atlanta Hawks take on the Brooklyn Nets in an April NBA matchup. Enjoy professional basketball as the regular season heats up at Barclays Center.

name: Off the Record: Acts of Restorative Justice
description: A participatory theatrical intervention aimed at the American Criminal Justice System that offers free consultations with criminal justice attorneys. The work is a collaboration between James Scruggs and Thomas Giovanni designed to offer real aid to those with criminal records.

name: Level Up & Zingara
description: A heavy-hitting night of bass and dubstep featuring a back-to-back performance by two rising stars.

name: Thievery Corporation
description: The acclaimed electronic duo Thievery Corporation brings their eclectic mix of acid jazz, downtempo, and world music to the venue. The show features a full live band performance for ages 16 and over.

name: Lontalius and gabby start
description: New Zealand singer-songwriter Lontalius performs bedroom pop with gabby start.

name: Scorched Earth
description: A new production appearing at St. Ann's Warehouse for a limited run in April. This performance is a featured part of the current 2025-26 season lineup.

name: The Super Mario Galaxy Movie
description: The Super Mario Bros. return in this animated galactic adventure produced by Illumination and Nintendo. Following the 2023 global hit, this sequel brings the iconic world of Mario Galaxy to the big screen.

name: The Dirty Three
description: The legendary Australian instrumental rock trio performs in New York City for the first time since 2009. Known for their unhinged and savage live shows, the band mixes punk gusto with improvisational jazz elements.

name: Ivy Baldwin Dance + Jeanine Durning
location: NYU Skirball Center for the Performing Arts
description: A world premiere double bill featuring bold new works from two of contemporary dance's most fearless voices. This evening pairs Baldwin’s rigorously inventive physical landscapes with Durning’s radical experiments in movement and language.

name: Ranger Trucco
description: One of tech house's fastest rising names, Ranger Trucco, performs a set of heavy grooves and original vocals.

name: Daniel Donato: Cosmic Country
description: Daniel Donato brings his 'Cosmic Country' sound to the Beacon Theatre, merging traditional honky-tonk with the improvisational spirit of jam bands. It's a night of virtuosic guitar work and modern Americana.

name: 49th & Main
description: Irish indie-pop duo 49th & Main performs a headline set featuring their blend of house-influenced pop music.

name: Angel Du$t
description: Hardcore supergroup Angel Du$t performs live with support from Outta Pocket, Jivebomb, and Vanity for a high-intensity evening of punk.

name: Bywater Call
description: A powerful 7-piece band blending southern soul, gospel, and blues-rock into a high-energy live experience.

name: morning dew: cyanotype & natural toners
description: Explore alternative photographic printing using organic materials like green tea, coffee, and wine. Instructor Mickey Aloisio leads sessions on cameraless photograms and contact printing from digital negatives.

name: 1tbsp
description: The electronic project of Maxwell Byrne delivers a night of indie-dance and house rhythms with support from Soltera.

name: Lpr Presents: Baths 15th Anniversary of Cerulean
description: Celebrate the 15th anniversary of the album Cerulean with a live performance by Baths. This special anniversary tour stop is presented by LPR at littlefield.

name: Queens Night Market
description: The Queens Night Market is a large, family-friendly open-air market featuring over 100 independent vendors selling international food, merchandise, and art. The event celebrates the rich cultural diversity of NYC with affordable prices and small-scale cultural performances.

name: WeBop Family Jazz Party: Jazz & Africa, Diaspora Connections
description: An interactive, high-energy musical adventure for families with children aged 8 months to 8 years. The WeBop Family Jazz Band invites kids to dance, sing, and explore the joyful rhythms of Africa and the diaspora.

name: Undead Doctor Scott
description: A musical séance featuring metaphysical music sent from the astral plane.

name: Improvised Music with Darja & Christoph
description: A specialized set of improvised music featuring accordion and guitar.

name: Nostalgix - Inferno Tour
description: Triple-threat talent Nostalgix brings her Inferno Tour to Brooklyn, blending house production with live rapping and infectious energy. The Iranian-Canadian artist continues to captivate global audiences with her electrifying stage presence.

name: Tigers Jaw with Hot Flash Heat Wave
description: Indie rock stalwarts Tigers Jaw perform with special guests Hot Flash Heat Wave for an evening of emo-tinged alternative rock.

name: James McMurtry
description: Acclaimed singer-songwriter James McMurtry performs his blend of folk-rock and Americana alongside BettySoo. Known for his sharp lyrical narratives, this is an essential show for folk music fans.

name: Moby-Dick: Reading the White Whale
description: A seminar-style reading group focused on Herman Melville's classic maritime masterpiece, Moby-Dick.

name: Klezmer and Other Displaced Musics in America
description: Scholar Walter Zev Feldman explores the background of the klezmer revitalization in 1960s American cities. Drawing from his memoir, he reflects on learning from Greek and eminent klezmer musicians.
short_name: Klezmer and Other Displaced Musics in America

name: Mannes Sounds: Pianists at the Opera
description: A donor appreciation concert exploring 19th-century grand opera through the lens of virtuoso piano techniques. Curated by Donald Wagner, the concert highlights the piano's ability to capture operatic grandeur.

name: Women on the Move: Judy Batalion on The Last Woman of Warsaw
description: National Jewish Book Award winner Judy Batalion discusses her debut novel about two Jewish women in Warsaw facing the danger of war. She explores the connection between historical research on resistance fighters and the process of writing fiction.
short_name: Judy Batalion on The Last Woman of Warsaw

name: Wasted x Van Alen
description: Pratt Institute visits Van Alen for their annual public conversation exploring the status of waste in architecture and the potential for reuse with minimal energy and capital expenditure.

name: The Albertine Book Club Reads "Free Day" by Inès Cagnati
description: A book club discussion of Inès Cagnati's novel Free Day, a translated French classic published by The New York Review of Books.
short_name: The Albertine Book Club Reads "Free Day" by Inès Cagnati

name: Golda Schultz Sings Barber & Stravinsky
location: David Geffen Hall at Lincoln Center
description: Soprano Golda Schultz joins conductor Kwamé Ryan for Samuel Barber’s Knoxville: Summer of 1915. The program also features the world premiere of a new work by George Lewis.

name: Bell X1 & Dowry Strings
description: Multi-platinum-selling indie rock trio Bell X1 performs new interpretations of their 25-year catalog. They are joined by the cross-genre ensemble Dowry Strings for this anticipated return to New York.

name: Graham100: The Centennial Celebration
description: The Martha Graham Dance Company celebrates its 100th anniversary with a special centennial program. The event honors the legacy and innovation of one of the most influential figures in modern dance history.

name: Monthly Jazz Jam - April 2026 - Honoring Billie Holiday
description: Join the Flushing Town Hall jazz community for a tribute to the legendary Billie Holiday. Musicians of all backgrounds are welcome to perform and improvise together during this monthly jam session.

name: New Directors/New Films 2026
description: Jointly presented with MoMA, this prestigious festival showcases emerging directors at the vanguard of cinema, continuing its long history of discovering major global talent.

name: kwn
description: An intimate performance showcasing the soulful R&B sounds of emerging artist kwn.

name: Bird and Nature Walk: Freshkills-North Park
description: Witness the return of spring migrants in the unique landscape of Freshkills Park. The walk focuses on identifying raptors and migrating waterfowl within this significant environmental restoration project.

name: My Excellency — With Jonathan Cohen & Gy Mirano
description: An intimate evening featuring Jonathan Cohen and Gy Mirano as they discuss their latest artistic project. The event explores the intersection of performance and literature.

name: Jim Gaffigan: Everything is Wonderful! Tour
description: Seven-time Grammy-nominated comedian Jim Gaffigan stops at the Beacon Theatre with his new world tour. Known for his relatable observational humor about family and food, Gaffigan remains one of the world's top stand-up performers.

name: kwn tour 2026
description: Emerging artist kwn visits Webster Hall as part of their 2026 tour, delivering a fresh and unique pop sound.

name: Bluegrass Improvisation for All Instruments with Stash Wyslouch - A Workshop
description: Iconoclastic flatpicker Stash Wyslouch leads a workshop on melodic and rhythmic development for bluegrass improvisation. Open to all instruments, the class covers practice routines and foundational skills.

name: Mattie & Debbie Album Release Party
description: Sean Trischka and Stash Wyslouch celebrate their debut duo album 'Satan’s Junction'. The performance features tight vocal harmonies, virtuosic bluegrass picking, and a mix of humorous and heartfelt anthems.

name: brooklyn fine art print fair
description: The fair's second edition convenes galleries, print publishers, and academic departments for a celebration of contemporary printmaking. This four-day event features leading independent artists.

name: The Belair Lip Bombs, Dust
description: Australian indie-rock band The Belair Lip Bombs performs live with support from the group Dust.

name: Mannes Sounds: Romance is in the Air
description: A multi-genre donor appreciation concert featuring works by Brahms, Bernstein, Puccini, and Cole Porter. The event showcases students from Mannes, the School of Jazz, and the School of Drama.
short_name: Mannes Sounds: Romance is in the Air

name: The Festival in Da Back
description: A richly textured and fiercely funny play about family legacy and the music that moves us, set in the crawfish capital of the world. Ghosts hum through the zydeco as the story explores who we crown, what we bury, and whether the music can still bring us home.

name: NateWantsToBattle: Phantom Burial Tour
description: NateWantsToBattle headlines a night of anime-inspired rock and pop-punk with guests Cam Steady and GENWUNNER.

name: Natalia Lafourcade
description: Mexican singer-songwriter Natalia Lafourcade gets back to basics with an intimate new tour performing hits and new tracks.

name: Steal This Story, Please!
description: A provocative look behind the scenes of journalist Amy Goodman's reports on the most consequential and routinely silenced stories of our time.

name: Two Feet: The Next Steps Tour
description: Two Feet performs his atmospheric blend of bluesy guitar riffs and heavy electronic beats live.
short_name: Two Feet: The Next Steps Tour
